Hi June, I can't set this up. I have no way to schedule recurring posts from here, so a 17:30 weekday note won't go out on its own. If I said it would, you'd be waiting on notes that never arrive.

You're a member of #strategic-pod, so I can write the "Pod end of day" note whenever someone asks me to. Ping me in the channel near 17:30 and I'll post a list of the day's new messages. If you want it fully automatic, a scheduled job would need to be set up by someone with access to that tooling.
